reader.decision: Accept the 14 November cutover. Have Aelita make the config and bounce-handling code changes before that date.
reader.decision_reason: My ruling is already recorded, and the message says no open item remains. The date falls before the 30 November shutdown and leaves margin before the month-end run. The remaining work is code changes, with the retry change being the urgent one.

reconstruction.problem: invoice-mailer has to move from smtp-old-1 to smtp-mx-2 before smtp-old-1 goes offline on 30 November. The code still has the old sender address (billing@larkspur.io), the old relay, and a retry setting of 12 retries at 60-second intervals. Hard and soft bounces are not told apart.
reconstruction.what_breaks: After 30 November, sends through smtp-old-1 fail. With the current retry values, handle_bounce can send 12 retries in 12 minutes to one recipient. smtp-mx-2 blocks the sender for 24 hours after more than 5 bounces in one hour, so one bad mailbox could stop all invoices.
reconstruction.fix: In mailer/config.py, change FROM_ADDRESS to invoices@mail.larkspur.io, switch SMTP_RELAY to smtp-mx-2.larkspur.internal on 14 November, and limit soft-bounce retries to 3 per hour. In mailer/bounces.py, make handle_bounce tell hard bounces from soft bounces and call message.mark_failed() at once on a hard bounce. No DNS change is needed, because mail.larkspur.io already has an SPF record for smtp-mx-2.
reconstruction.cost: Not stated beyond the code edits in two files. The retry change cannot wait.
